geography: Archer City, Mount Barry, Briar Creek, Rattlesnake Canyon and Craddock bonebed
Texas and New Mexico, United States
overview: Named Dimetrodon and cf. Dimetrodon teeth preserve differences in tooth edges and cusps. A separate character-matrix study compares sphenacodontid relationships; neither the isolated teeth nor the sampled tree identifies a direct mammalian ancestor.

ecology.diet: Predatory feeding inferred from sphenacodontid tooth anatomy; individual prey is not preserved
ecology.habitat: Fully terrestrial apex-predator interpretation for the sampled sphenacodontids; habitat breadth is unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Not measured by the dental sample
ecology.bodySize: The profile does not infer a genus-wide mass or body-length range
ecology.guild: Terrestrial predator inference bounded to the source's sampled ecological interpretation
ecology.dietZh: 所取样的楔齿龙类牙齿支持研究中的捕食性解释。这些标本没有保存可识别的猎物。
ecology.habitatZh: 所引样本来自得克萨斯州和新墨西哥州的早二叠世产地。它不能说明该属完整的栖地范围。
ecology.locomotionZh: 牙齿研究没有测量其运动方式或运动表现。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 这份牙齿档案没有推算该属整体的体重或体长范围。
ecology.guildZh: 陆生顶级捕食者是研究对所取样楔齿龙类的解释，并非直接观察到的摄食行为，也不是该属完整的生态功能群判定。

traits: MCZ 2779 snout with enlarged anterior maxillary tooth
MCZ 2028 and UMMP 9722 dentary teeth with lingual cusp variation
Carina and denticle character changes optimized in the sampled phylogeny
evidenceSummary: The study sample comes from Texas and New Mexico and spans 290.1–273 Ma. Predatory feeding and repeated dental-character change are interpretations of the sampled material, not records of particular prey or the genus's complete history.

title.en: Named teeth show differences in edges and cusps
title.zh: 具名牙齿显示齿缘与齿尖差异

text.en: Brink and Reisz describe skull and tooth material from named Dimetrodon species and cf. Dimetrodon, including an enlarged anterior maxillary tooth and variation in lingual cusps. Their matrix compares carinae, the sharp tooth edges, and denticles, the small serrations. Tooth form supports a predatory interpretation, but no prey is preserved with these specimens.
text.zh: Brink 和 Reisz 描述了具名 Dimetrodon 物种及 cf. Dimetrodon 的头骨和牙齿材料，包括增大的前部上颌牙与舌侧齿尖差异。矩阵比较齿刃（牙齿的锐利边缘）和小锯齿。牙齿形态支持捕食性解释，但这些标本没有保存猎物。

title.en: A character matrix tests sampled relationships
title.zh: 特征矩阵检验取样类群之间的关系

text.en: The sampled matrix places the included Dimetrodon species within Sphenacodontidae and optimizes repeated dental-character changes. It tests relationships among included forms, not direct mammalian ancestry. The 290.1–273 Ma interval is the Early Permian Texas and New Mexico sample window, not a complete global genus range.
text.zh: 取样矩阵将纳入的 Dimetrodon 物种置于楔齿龙科，并优化牙齿性状的反复变化。它检验的是纳入类群之间的关系，不是哺乳动物的直系祖先关系。290.1–273 Ma 是得克萨斯州和新墨西哥州样本的早二叠世时间窗口，并非该属完整的全球分布年代。

overviewZh: 具名 Dimetrodon 和 cf. Dimetrodon 牙齿显示齿缘与齿尖存在差异。另一项特征矩阵研究比较楔齿龙类的亲缘关系；孤立牙齿和取样树都不能确定哺乳动物的直系祖先。
evidenceSummaryZh: 研究样本来自得克萨斯州和新墨西哥州，年代跨度为 290.1–273 Ma。捕食性摄食和牙齿性状的反复变化是对样本的解释，并非具体猎物记录或该属的完整历史。
traitsZh: 所描述的 MCZ 2779 吻部保存了一枚增大的前部上颌牙。这项观察只适用于该标本。
MCZ 2028 和 UMMP 9722 保存的齿骨牙齿显示舌侧齿尖形态有差异；这不能用于诊断每个 Dimetrodon 物种或个体。
取样系统树对齿刃和小锯齿的变化进行优化。这一矩阵结果描述纳入分析的类群，不是祖先序列。

commonNameZh: 达善沟基干兽孔类标本
overview: IVPP V15424 is a partial snout, not a complete skeleton; its 71-character matrix placement is sample-dependent, and the cited account reports no reliable direct formation date.
overviewZh: 这里的早期兽孔类记录是一段吻部，而非完整骨架。正模 IVPP V15424 来自中二叠世大山口地点，吻部长约 100 mm。一项已发表分析编码 71 个解剖性状，并在该矩阵中将 *Raranimus dashankouensis* 放在兽孔类基部附近。犬齿组合和其他头部性状可用于检验这一矩阵位置，但化石不是已证实的祖先；所引研究指出大山口组缺少可靠的直接放射性定年。

ecology.diet: Carnivory is inferred from the snout’s cranial and dental morphology.
ecology.habitat: The Xidagou Formation provides a continental depositional context; the animal’s exact habitat is unresolved.
ecology.locomotion: The partial snout does not preserve evidence of locomotion.
ecology.bodySize: The only described holotype is an approximately 100 mm snout fragment; this is not a body-length estimate.
ecology.guild: The dentition has been interpreted as that of a small terrestrial predator; this remains an inference.
ecology.dietZh: 食肉性是根据吻部的头骨与牙齿形态推断的。
ecology.habitatZh: 西大沟组提供了大陆沉积环境背景；该动物的确切生境仍未确定。
ecology.locomotionZh: 部分吻部没有保存可用于判断运动方式的证据。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 唯一描述过的正模是一段约 100 毫米长的吻部碎片；这不是体长估计。
ecology.guildZh: 其齿列被解释为属于小型陆生捕食者；这仍是推断。

traits: Partial snout combining cranial and dental characters used in the diagnosis
The diagnosis discusses a double-canine condition
The matrix places Raranimus near the base of sampled Therapsida
evidenceSummary: The 71-character matrix tests placement from a partial snout; the cited account reports no reliable direct Dashankou date, and the result does not establish ancestry.
evidenceSummaryZh: 具名正模和 71 性状矩阵为检验早期兽孔类亲缘关系提供材料，但结果受这段不完整吻部及其编码方式限制。所引研究没有给大山口组提供可靠的直接放射性定年；矩阵位置与吻部残片都不证明祖先关系。

readerLimitations.en: The placement comes from a 71-character analysis of a partial snout; the cited account reports no reliable direct radiometric date for the Dashankou sequence. The matrix position and broad stage-based display do not demonstrate direct ancestry or a precise lineage duration.
readerLimitations.zh: 其位置来自对一段吻部残片编码的 71 项性状分析；所引记述没有给大山口层序提供可靠的直接放射性定年。矩阵中的位置和按阶估算的宽泛展示范围，都不能证明直系祖先关系或精确谱系延续时间。

traitsZh: 部分吻部材料结合了用于鉴定的颅骨和牙齿特征。
鉴别描述讨论了双犬齿状态。
在所取样的兽孔类中，矩阵分析将 Raranimus 置于接近基部的位置。

overview: CT data from the named jaws MCZ7/95A–B and MCZ10/G95 show tooth-bearing dentaries, a trough behind the dentary, and rows of teeth with wear surfaces. The cited matrix places sampled Late Triassic haramiyids outside crown Mammalia; tooth form and wear also support plant processing and a backward jaw stroke, but these are interpretations rather than direct records of diet, movement or ancestry.
overviewZh: 具名颌骨 MCZ7/95A–B 和 MCZ10/G95 的 CT 数据显示了承齿齿骨、齿骨后方的沟槽，以及带有磨耗面的多排牙齿。所引矩阵将取样的晚三叠世哈拉米亚类置于哺乳动物冠群之外；牙齿形态和磨耗还支持植物加工及下颌后移的解释，但它们并非食性、运动或祖先关系的直接记录。

ecology.diet: Complex teeth and wear facets support plant processing; actual diet is not observed.
ecology.habitat: The fossils come from continental deposits of the Fleming Fjord Formation; the animal's living habitat is not established by the jaws.
ecology.locomotion: Movement is not preserved by the jaw material.
ecology.bodySize: Described as a small mammaliaform; the jaw sample does not establish whole-body mass.
ecology.guild: Plant processing is inferred from the teeth; an ecological role is not directly observed.
ecology.dietZh: 复杂牙齿和磨耗面支持其能够处理植物；实际食物并未被直接观察。
ecology.habitatZh: 化石来自 Fleming Fjord 组的陆相沉积；仅凭颌骨无法确定动物的生活生境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 颌部材料没有保存移动信息。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 它被描述为一种小型哺乳形类；下颌样本不能确定全身质量。
ecology.guildZh: 根据牙齿推断其处理植物；其生态角色并未被直接观察。

traits: Jaw-joint condyle and a trough behind the dentary
Rows of complex teeth behind the front of the jaw
Backward jaw movement inferred from tooth-wear geometry
evidenceSummary: The Greenland jaws support anatomical and tooth-wear observations; placement outside crown Mammalia and plant processing are interpretations. The 205.7–201.4 Ma Rhaetian interval translates the formation context, not the full range of Haramiyida or the age of crown Mammalia.
evidenceSummaryZh: 格陵兰具名颌骨支持解剖和牙齿磨耗观察；哺乳动物冠群之外的位置及植物加工都属于解释。205.7–201.4 Ma 的瑞替期区间是地层背景的换算，不代表哈拉米亚目的完整延限，也不是哺乳动物冠群的年代。
traitsZh: 颌关节髁突，以及齿骨后方的沟槽。
下颌前部之后排列着数列复杂牙齿。
根据齿面磨耗几何形态推断下颌可向后移动。

commonNameZh: 摩尔根兽类颅骨标本组
overview: In the Lower Jurassic skull comparison, Morganucodon watsoni from Wales and M. oehleri from China share a described mosaic: the squamosal contacts the dentary while the articular–quadrate joint remains. The 26 mm measurement belongs to the M. watsoni skull, not to body size across the order.

ecology.diet: The skulls preserve distinct incisors, canines, premolars, and molars. That dental differentiation is anatomical evidence, but the study does not directly observe diet.
ecology.habitat: The described specimens come from Lower Jurassic deposits in Wales and China. These localities are representative material, not a complete geographic range or proof of a single life habitat.
ecology.locomotion: The skull comparison does not establish how Morganucodontans moved.
ecology.bodySize: The described M. watsoni skull is 26 mm long; the M. oehleri skull is slightly larger. These skull measurements do not establish body size across the order.
ecology.guild: Two skull samples do not support an order-wide ecological guild.
ecology.dietZh: 头骨保存了形态有别的门齿、犬齿、前臼齿和臼齿。这种牙齿分化是解剖证据，但研究没有直接观察食性。
ecology.habitatZh: 所描述的标本来自威尔士和中国的下侏罗统沉积层。这些地点仅代表已研究的材料，既不构成完整地理分布范围，也不能证明其只有一种生活环境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 头骨比较不能确定 Morganucodontans 如何移动。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 所描述的 M. watsoni 头骨长 26 mm；M. oehleri 的头骨略大。这些头骨测量值无法确定整个目级类群的体型。
ecology.guildZh: 两组头骨样本不足以支持为整个目指定生态功能类群。

traits: The described M. watsoni skull measures 26 mm; the M. oehleri skull is slightly larger.
The teeth are differentiated into incisors, canines, premolars, and molars.
The described jaw shows squamosal–dentary contact while retaining the articular–quadrate joint.
evidenceSummary: Kermack and colleagues describe the two Morganucodon skulls and their jaw anatomy. Luo and colleagues include Morganucodontans in a mammaliaform character analysis. The skull observations and the matrix placement answer different questions; neither establishes a complete order history or a direct ancestor.
overviewZh: 下侏罗统头骨比较中，来自威尔士的 Morganucodon watsoni 与来自中国的 M. oehleri 呈现所述镶嵌特征：鳞骨与齿骨相接，同时保留关节骨—方骨关节。26 mm 是 M. watsoni 头骨的测量值，不代表整个目级类群的体型。
evidenceSummaryZh: Kermack 等人描述了两件 Morganucodon 头骨及其颌部解剖；Luo 等人在哺乳形类特征分析中纳入摩根齿兽类。头骨观察和矩阵位置回答的是不同问题；两者都没有建立完整的目级历史或直系祖先关系。

scope.en: Kermack et al. (1981), pp. 1–158, especially 1–8: Morganucodon watsoni and M. oehleri skull samples, the 26 mm skull, jaw articulation and dentition.
scope.zh: Kermack 等（1981），第 1–158 页，尤其第 1–8 页：Morganucodon watsoni 与 M. oehleri 头骨样本、26 毫米头骨、颌关节及牙列。

readerSources.title: In quest for a phylogeny of Mesozoic mammals

scope.en: Luo et al. (2002), pp. 1–78: mammaliaform taxon sampling, Morganucodontan relationships and the stated crown Mammalia boundary.
scope.zh: Luo 等（2002），第 1–78 页：哺乳形类取样、摩根齿兽类关系及文中采用的冠群哺乳动物边界。

title.en: Contact between jaw bones beside an older joint
title.zh: 较早的颌关节仍在，邻骨已相接

text.en: In the Lower Jurassic skull comparison, Morganucodon watsoni from Wales and M. oehleri from China share a described mosaic: the squamosal contacts the dentary while the articular–quadrate joint remains. The 26 mm measurement belongs to the M. watsoni skull, not to body size across the order.
text.zh: 下侏罗统头骨比较中，来自威尔士的 Morganucodon watsoni 与来自中国的 M. oehleri 呈现所述镶嵌特征：鳞骨与齿骨相接，同时保留关节骨—方骨关节。26 mm 是 M. watsoni 头骨的测量值，不代表整个目级类群的体型。

title.en: Named skulls and a sampled mammaliaform analysis
title.zh: 具名头骨与取样的哺乳形类分析

text.en: Kermack and colleagues describe the two Morganucodon skulls and their jaw anatomy. Luo and colleagues include Morganucodontans in a mammaliaform character analysis. The skull observations and the matrix placement answer different questions; neither establishes a complete order history or a direct ancestor.
text.zh: Kermack 等人描述了两件 Morganucodon 头骨及其颌部解剖；Luo 等人在哺乳形类特征分析中纳入摩根齿兽类。头骨观察和矩阵位置回答的是不同问题；两者都没有建立完整的目级历史或直系祖先关系。

traitsZh: 所描述的 M. watsoni 头骨长 26 毫米；M. oehleri 的头骨稍大。
牙齿分化为门齿、犬齿、前臼齿和臼齿。
所描述的下颌显示鳞骨与齿骨相接，同时保留关节骨—方骨关节。

overview: Near-complete holotype IVPP V16051 preserves a detached ectotympanic and malleus beside ossified Meckel's cartilage. The combination records separated ear bones and a remaining connection to the dentary in one fossil; it does not directly show soft-tissue motion or prove direct ancestry.

ecology.diet: Animal-feeding diet inferred from eutriconodont dentition
ecology.habitat: Jiufotang lacustrine depositional setting; exact life habitat unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Terrestrial locomotion inferred; performance not measured
ecology.bodySize: Small-bodied mammal known from a near-complete skeleton
ecology.guild: Small terrestrial faunivore inferred from dentition
ecology.dietZh: 所引研究根据真三尖齿兽类牙齿推断其取食动物性食物。正模没有保存食物或直接摄食观察。
ecology.habitatZh: 标本来自九佛堂组的湖相沉积环境。这一沉积背景不能确定动物的确切生活栖地。
ecology.locomotionZh: 陆地运动方式是根据保存的解剖结构推断的；研究没有测量运动表现。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 资料将 Liaoconodon 描述为小型哺乳动物，并提到近完整骨架；没有给出量化的体型或体重范围。
ecology.guildZh: 本页根据牙齿推断其为小型陆生食虫或食肉动物，并非报告直接观察到的生态角色。

traits: Ossified Meckel’s cartilage linking ear and dentary
evidenceSummary: IVPP V16051 directly supports the described ear and jaw anatomy. A stabilizing function for the ossified cartilage and its evolutionary significance remain interpretations, not observed performance or ancestry.

title.en: A detached middle-ear element beside jaw cartilage
title.zh: 分离的中耳骨旁仍有颌部软骨

text.en: Near-complete holotype IVPP V16051 preserves a detached ectotympanic and malleus alongside ossified Meckel's cartilage. The ectotympanic forms part of the middle ear, the malleus transmits sound, and Meckel's cartilage runs along the lower jaw in mammals. Their preserved arrangement documents an ear–jaw connection in this specimen, not soft-tissue motion or a universal transition stage.
text.zh: 近完整正模 IVPP V16051 保存了分离的鼓骨和锤骨，也保存了骨化的麦氏软骨。鼓骨是中耳的一部分，锤骨传递声音；哺乳动物的麦氏软骨沿下颌延伸。该标本保存的组合记录了耳—颌联系，但不能直接显示软组织运动，也不是普遍过渡阶段的证明。

title.en: Transitional mammalian middle ear from a new Cretaceous Jehol eutriconodont
title.zh: Transitional mammalian middle ear from a new Cretaceous Jehol eutriconodont

scope.en: Liaoconodon hui: 181–185; Figures 1–4. Limited to the cited specimens, samples or analyses.
scope.zh: Liaoconodon hui：原文定位 181–185; Figures 1–4。本文仅使用所引标本、样本或分析的对应结果。

overviewZh: 正模 IVPP V16051 保存分离的鼓骨、锤骨及与齿骨相连的骨化麦氏软骨。
evidenceSummaryZh: IVPP V16051 支持所述耳部与下颌组合；软骨功能的解释仍有不确定性。
traitsZh: 近完整正模保存了分离的鼓骨和锤骨。
保存的标本中，骨化麦氏软骨将耳部骨骼与齿骨相连。
研究还报告了一具近完整、关节连接的颅后骨架；耳—颌解释仍以正模解剖为依据。
